|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[IG Bodyguard Droid]], under the new title; it is the current text. The images are the Master List slip and the Players Committee card image, which print it; the release-sheet slip prints the original card (see [[IG Bodyguard Droid]]).
* '''Original''' ([[IG Bodyguard Droid]]): printed as “•••IG Bodyguard Droid”, text as given in the Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet (official text as of 3 June 2011; the surviving copy was re-made 25 July 2011)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf#page=2 Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of June 3, 2011"; copy re-made 25 July 2011), page 2, slip 6 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022223058/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf#page=2 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Shockstaff deploys and fires for free on this droid. While on Blockade Flagship or Coruscant (or with Cyborg Commander), this droid is Heroic and power +2. Your characters here are immune to Ambush, Clash Of Sabers, and attrition < 4.” The original-sheet card image ([[:File:VL-history-1273-6-front-original.png]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-03-IG_100_MagnaGuard.png]], named after the later title) print it. The PC website card list (21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013) shows the same words with “Power +2” and “Immune to” capitalised and the title as “IG Bodyguard droid”<ref name="cl-VBlock7-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 21 July 2012] (Internet Archive); same text in every capture to [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 11 January 2013]</ref> (capitals only; not treated as a separate version).
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): on 29 January 2013 the [[Players Committee]] announced the persona-name change “IG Bodyguard Droid ---> IG-100 MagnaGuard”, effective immediately (old slips stayed tournament-legal)<ref name="persona2013">[https://web.archive.org/web/20130221003512/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=350&catid=1&Itemid=117 New Persona Changes], [[Players Committee]], 29 January 2013. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20130221003512/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=350&catid=1&Itemid=117 Internet Archive].</ref>. The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Dark Side p. 9) prints the card as “•••IG-100 MagnaGuard”, with “Cyborg Commander” changed to “Grievous”<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=9, page 9. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=9 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Shockstaff deploys and fires for free on this droid. While on Blockade Flagship or Coruscant (or with Grievous), this droid is Heroic and power +2. Your characters here are immune to Ambush, Clash Of Sabers, and attrition < 4.” The Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1273-6-front-master.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-D-ig100magnaguard-pre.gif]]) print it.
